API Module

Main entry point for the Book Recommender System FastAPI application.

This module initializes the FastAPI app, configures middleware, and sets up the lifespan context manager for startup and shutdown events.

api.main.lifespan(app: FastAPI)[source]

Manages the startup and shutdown events of the FastAPI application.

Displays startup information, initializes the database, and logs available API documentation endpoints.

Parameters:

app (FastAPI) – The FastAPI application instance.

Utility class for language-specific text normalization and cleaning.

Parses and cleans genre strings, removing spaces for consistency.

Cleans and tokenizes Persian text using Hazm or basic regex rules.

src.preprocessing.preprocess_dataset(output_path: Path = WindowsPath('D:/Book-Recommender-System/backend/data/processed/books_clean.csv')) → DataFrame[source]

Loads raw datasets, cleans text, and engineers the ‘soup’ feature for TF-IDF. The ‘soup’ combines title, author, genre, and description with specific weights to guide the TF-IDF vectorizer towards more important features. Also generates a clean vocabulary JSON for frontend autocomplete.

class src.recommender.BookRecommender[source]

Bases: object

Core Recommendation Engine using Content-Based Filtering. Utilizes TF-IDF vectors and Cosine Similarity to match user profiles with books.

get_popular_books(n: int = 10, languages: List[str] = None) → List[Dict[str, Any]][source]

Fallback method for Cold Start or general discovery.

load_resources()[source]

Loads the processed dataset and pre-computed TF-IDF matrix into memory.

recommend_by_book_id(book_id: str, top_n: int = 5, lang: str | None = None) → List[Dict[str, Any]][source]

Finds books similar to a specific book ID.

recommend_user_profile(preferred_languages: List[str], favorite_genres: List[str] = None, favorite_authors: List[str] = None, liked_book_ids: List[str] = None, disliked_genres: List[str] = None, disliked_authors: List[str] = None, disliked_book_ids: List[str] = None, top_n: int = 5) → List[Dict[str, Any]][source]

Generates personalized recommendations based on weighted user preferences.

Weighting Strategy (Research-Backed): - Liked Books: 0.50 (Strongest signal of exact taste) - Liked Genres: 0.25 (Moderate signal of thematic preference) - Liked Authors: 0.15 (Weaker signal to prevent author overfitting) - Disliked items receive symmetrical negative weights to actively filter them out. - Book Rating adds a minor 0.10 boost to the final similarity score.
